title: src/index.js: Worker Entry Point
description: Worker that handles /api/questions for GET and POST, /api/questions/:id/upvote for POST, with validation and D1 database operations.

steps.description: Header and constant: comment about Workers Assets, MAX_LENGTH=280.
Json helper: creates Response with JSON stringified body and status.
ListQuestions: SELECT from questions ordered by votes DESC, id ASC, returns JSON.
AddQuestion: parses JSON, validates text length 1-280, INSERT with RETURNING, returns 201.
Upvote: UPDATE votes + 1 WHERE id = ?, RETURNING, returns row or 404.
Fetch: routes to listQuestions, addQuestion, upvote based on pathname and method, 404 for unknown.
